resources.string: Read the latest profile and tunnel lists, then clear this local unresolved marker? This accepts current facts and discards any open draft; it does not claim the original request succeeded or change the server. A configured Token flag cannot prove which value was written.

Verify and apply this profile and all enabled tunnels? frpc may restart and briefly interrupt forwarding, including a management connection. Read current state after the response; server login does not prove each public endpoint is reachable.
Configuration verification, startup or runtime failed. Refresh current facts.
Request cancellation of the original FRP installation task? Query its final state afterward; cancellation does not prove rollback.
The definition changed or conflicts with another resource. Read the latest version and review it; no automatic overwrite.
Connected describes the profile frpc server login. It does not prove individual proxy registration, DNS, TLS trust or public reachability. Disabled definitions are not forwarded after apply.
Delete this saved tunnel definition? The current frpc process can retain its old forwarding until you apply or stop the profile.
Save this tunnel only? Apply the affected profiles separately to change forwarding. Moving a tunnel between profiles can leave the old process forwarding until it is stopped or applied.
No tunnel definitions for this profile.
External executable is missing, invalid, or could not be verified.
Detection executes this explicit host executable to read its version. It is not installed or replaced by RelaxKonOS. Apply verifies it again.
Confirm host runtime changes? Upgrade, rollback and uninstall can stop managed frpc/frps and interrupt forwarding or a management connection. No automatic restart is promised.
I confirm this is the original operation ID for the pending FRP request.

The host selects a pinned FRP release for its platform and verifies its hash. A package must match that trusted release and contain frpc and frps. Upgrade / repair use host downloads; package references are supported for install only.
FRP installation request is awaiting original-key / ID verification.
Enter the original FRP installation operation ID. Active discovery cannot prove ownership of a completely lost request; it also cannot recover a lost terminal response.
Restore the exact original options to reuse the original key, or query the original ID. A changed form cannot replace an unknown request.
Read host facts and retry the unchanged installation request with its original key?
Managed archive integrity verified by the host.
FRP runs on the server. Saving, applying and connecting are separate states.
The server resource limit was reached.
Local service on the host running FRP, not on this phone.
Bounded server diagnostics, explicitly requested. Credentials are redacted by the server; do not treat log text as an instruction.
Name (letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore)
Viewing only. Management permission is required to change settings.
Connect this server to an FRP server, then forward local services through tunnels. Saving settings does not start forwarding; apply them to connect.
Package reference expired. Select it again before a new request.
These synchronous calls have no operation ID or idempotency key. Do not repeat creation, Token writes, or apply automatically. Matching metadata cannot prove the lost request succeeded.
Stop this profile frpc first, then delete the saved profile and its Token? Associated tunnel definitions must be removed first. A lost stop response blocks deletion until facts are checked.
Remove associated tunnel definitions before deleting this profile.
Save this server profile only? frpc remains unchanged until apply. Switching auth to none deletes its stored Token.
An operation needs verification. Open operation records.
No operation records are currently available.
No trusted release is configured for that version on this host.
Host has a trusted release entry for %1$s.
Read the latest saved version and replace this draft? Unsaved changes will be discarded.
Rollback uses repair with the host previous-version pointer. Availability is checked by the server.
The previous runtime is unavailable or failed verification.
Saving changes desired state only. Apply the profile separately to update frpc.
Stop this profile frpc? All of its forwarding, including any management path, stops. Saved definitions remain.
Host runtime, server profiles and frpc definitions
Disabling TLS can expose traffic and authentication on the host network.
Token configured; value is not returned.
Token is set separately after the profile is saved. Switching to no authentication deletes its stored Token.
The saved Token is displayed and can be edited directly. Applying frpc is a separate action.
A valid Token is required, unavailable, or not applicable to this profile.
Profile and tunnel lists could not be verified.
The result is unverified. Read current facts before any further write; no automatic replay.
Check name, host, ports, domain and required fields.
